resources.string: JPEG photos are sent as JPEG XL: the same photo in about a fifth less space.
The JPEG stays as it is: every app can show it.
The JPEG XL replaces the JPEG once the server has it, and the JPEG goes to the gallery\'s trash. Only this app can show JPEG XL.
Needs \"Media management\" access, so each JPEG goes to the trash without asking.
